name: The store's webhook answered 500, then too late
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: A paid-order webhook the Worker fails (a 500, or no answer in the 5 s the store waits) is sent again by the store, and the order gets its one ticket and one claim-link email, never two.
blast_radius: Two orders in the stand-in store, and the throwaway park's answers about them; nothing else the store answers is touched.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: order A's first delivery, the store failing
observations.fix: answer a webhook whose work failed with a 5xx, so the store sends it again (a 2xx without the ticket loses the order)

observations.what: order A sent again, then once more
observations.value: HTTP 200 {"tickets":1,"sent":true} in 43 ms; HTTP 200 {"tickets":1,"sent":true} in 28 ms; emails 1
observations.fix: make each step of a paid order safe to repeat: the desk's tickets once per order, the claim-link email once (storeHooks.ts)

observations.what: order B's first delivery, the store's answer held back
order B sent again while the first delivery was still at work, then once more
observations.value: HTTP 200 {"tickets":1,"sent":true} in 3063 ms; HTTP 200 {"tickets":1,"sent":true} in 24 ms; emails 1
observations.fix: two deliveries of one order at once must not both email the claim link: hold the order while one delivery works on it (storeHooks.ts)
